history.prompt: Minimalist flat composition, one large solid rectangular block resting on two smaller wedges, but one wedge is missing or removed, causing a deliberate asymmetry and imbalance. Two or three flat colours from a muted palette of slate grey and terracotta, hard edges, generous negative space, gallery-print calm.

style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly featuring a modular processing track with an unlatched inspection gate physically removed and resting beside the main housing. Studio render on a neutral seamless backdrop. Matte surfaces with moulding seams and soft contact shadows, single soft key light, matte muted palette with a slight accent on the removed gate mechanism. Generous negative space.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, logos, branding, plain cubes, spheres, glowing brains, abstract shapes, humans, faces
rationale: The article details a structural change to a system architecture—specifically, the removal of a critical validation gate. A matte clay render grounds this abstract software ablation using a tangible mechanical metaphor of a modular assembly with a removed inspection gate.
subject: a modular processing track with one unlatched inspection gate physically removed from the main assembly
alt_text: A modular mechanical track with an unlatched inspection gate removed from the main assembly line.
caption: Removing a single validation gate from a multi-agent learning loop can severely degrade its reasoning capabilities.
title: AI Agent Rollback Gate Ablation
